text_block_list.text:
Senior Class. A year to discover a new 
kind of cool. To kick it off, I came to 
Hatsumode with Vodka.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, I don't mind going all out for New 
Year's, but... relying on the gods of all 
things?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I ain't pathetic enough to go clinging to 
God for help.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: If anything, God's the one clingin' to me!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
D-Don't worry about every little detail! 
It's all about momentum with these things, 
momentum!
choice_data_list: Then don't you have a wish?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, I have one, but... there's no way in 
hell some god's gonna grant it."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Hm? But come to think of it, there's 
someone right here who can grant it.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
All right, I'm counting on you here, 
Trainer. Make me even cooler than before.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. To put it simply... Make it look 
like a huge motorcycle!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Like, *vroooom*! *KABLAM*!! Something like 
that!

...That's not clear at all. So what Vodka 
is trying to say is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's it right there! Big bikes can 
guzzle down so much gas!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wanna become the kind of runner whose 
fuel tank never runs dry. Got any ideas 
how?

Speaking of endless fuel, there's only one 
place to go. The place we've arrived at 
is...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a burger joint. Yeah, guess I'll grab 
a bite. Not like I'm the type who has to 
eat traditional Japanese food just 'cause 
it's New Year's.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Let's chow down on chicken and wash it 
down with cola! Come on, when it comes to 
calories, the more the merrier!

Eat wildly, devouring everything in sight. 
With this much fuel, there's no way I'll 
run out of gas.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, that's it right there! Big bikes have 
huge engines, so they can handle any road 
no problem.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I wanna build that kind of relentless 
stamina, too. Got any ideas how?
The place that came to mind was...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a night pool? Sounds great! That 
oughta build up your lung capacity in no 
time!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Nobody's around, so time to swim in style! 
Dripping wet and lookin' good, that's 
Vodka for ya!

Vodka turns into a ferocious fish, 
swimming tirelessly through the empty 
pool. Her physical abilities seem to have 
leveled up.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
A sidecar? Ah, yeah, those definitely get 
attached to the side of those gigantic 
motorcycles.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
You can load all kinds of stuff in there, 
looks real handy. If only I had that kind 
of carrying capacity...

Speaking of cramming, it's gotta be that 
place. The place I took Vodka to was...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The library?! You're not seriously 
planning on cramming knowledge into my 
head, are you?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
G-Give me a break. I'm way over capacity 
here! I'm no good with this kind of— 
WHOAAAA?!

I spent the entire New Year's holiday 
cramming knowledge. It feels like my 
capacity to learn has increased.
